sheet.summary: Mint identified four Indian companies trading below ₹200 per share that offer annual dividend yields ranging between 2.53% and 19%. For salaried Indian households, dividend-paying equities can create a secondary cash flow stream alongside monthly salary income. However, households must remember that corporate dividends are fully taxable at individual slab rates and subject to a 10% tax deduction at source, meaning net returns differ significantly from headline yields.
